scenes.conflict: Marek believes any risk to the stores is a betrayal. He rations power and food, forbids unauthorized trips into the Wastes, and dismisses her as reckless.
scenes.goal: Tamsin wants to warn the Council that Helios Wake's beam is burning Westreach's outer fields and ask for an expedition to the vault.
scenes.outcome: The Council refuses and forbids any expedition. Tamsin decides to go anyway, which sets her against Marek.
scenes.summary: The first crops burn under the satellite's beam. Tamsin pleads her case before the Council, and Marek shuts her down in measured, controlling tones.
scenes.title: The Burning Terraces

scenes.conflict: Juno, who is overprotective and conflict-averse, fears the Council and fears Tamsin repeating her mother's fate. The Council also withholds the spare parts the Wardens need to keep the uplink alive.
scenes.goal: Tamsin wants to confirm from the Array's control logs and her mother's logbook that the satellite can be reclaimed with old codes.
scenes.outcome: Tamsin reads the uplink logs and learns that only codes from the Deepseed Vault could restore control. Juno quietly agrees to prepare the Array for those codes.
scenes.summary: In the control hall, Tamsin uses Uplink Reading to study the faults. Juno shares her mother's unfinished repair notes.
scenes.title: Her Mother's Logbook

scenes.conflict: Orrin is secretive and distrusts the young and the Council. He swore to guard the vault's location, and he is guilt-ridden over a past silence.
scenes.goal: Tamsin wants the route to the Deepseed Vault from Orrin, one of the last Seedkeepers who remembers it.
scenes.outcome: Orrin agrees to guide her but withholds the full route until he trusts her. The two set out in secret.
scenes.summary: Tamsin finds the coughing botanist among the living walls. His oath to the Seedkeepers clashes with the famine the satellite and the storm will bring, and he reluctantly accepts.
scenes.title: The Botanist of the Living Walls

scenes.conflict: Marek learns of the plan and moves to block the gates. Juno must choose whether to defy him openly.
scenes.goal: Tamsin and Orrin want to leave Westreach with filters and supplies before the Council can stop them.
scenes.outcome: Juno covers their exit by claiming a repair mission and gives Tamsin her mother's notes. The pair reach the Wastes, and Marek hardens his stance.
scenes.summary: The departure is tense. Juno's quiet courage buys them time as Marek's guards close in.
scenes.title: Past the Gates

scenes.conflict: Acid dust storms clog the filters and the crawler's stored sunlight runs low. Tamsin's improvising clashes with Orrin's caution, and Orrin's cough worsens.
scenes.goal: Cross the first stretch of the Wastes in a sealed solar-powered crawler toward Rustmarket Halt.
scenes.outcome: Tamsin's Crawler Fieldcraft gets them through, but the crawler is damaged. Orrin reveals only the next landmark, not the full route.
scenes.summary: Dust and glass test the crawler and the partners' trust, and the rule that unfiltered dust causes lung damage within hours raises the stakes.
scenes.title: Dust Seas and Glass Drifts

scenes.conflict: Kesra demands tolls Tamsin cannot pay and distrusts arcology folk. She is also torn between her clan's bargaining position and her wish to help.
scenes.goal: Get filters, repairs and a guide for the rest of the Wastes.
scenes.outcome: Orrin's old trade friendship persuades Kesra to guide them. Tamsin repairs Kesra's crawler as payment, and Kesra asks for a lasting trade agreement with Westreach.
scenes.summary: At the nomad trading post, the bargain begins as a transaction. Orrin's word and Tamsin's repair skill start to turn it into trust.
scenes.title: The Price of the Crossing

scenes.conflict: The storm is approaching early and Helios Wake's beam sweeps the route. Tamsin's recklessness endangers the crawler, and Orrin still withholds the final passphrases.
scenes.goal: Reach the vault's mountain before the solar storm disables unshielded electronics and heats the surface.
scenes.outcome: Kesra's Waste Navigation finds a shaded route. Tamsin admits her fear, and Orrin begins to share the route in full.
scenes.summary: The three race the storm, relying on Kesra's skill. Honesty about their fears deepens the partnership.
scenes.title: Signs of the Solar Storm

scenes.conflict: The door needs Seedkeeper passphrases and landmarks, and the dormant solar-fed power core must be woken without explosives or firearms.
scenes.goal: Open the sealed vault before the storm arrives.
scenes.outcome: Orrin gives the full passphrases and Tamsin wakes the core with pressure tools and mirrors. The door opens just as the storm nears.
scenes.summary: Orrin trusts Tamsin with the final secret and she repairs the core.
scenes.title: The Sealed Door

scenes.conflict: Tamsin is tempted to take the codes for personal vindication, while Orrin and Kesra argue over who may hold the seeds under the custom that no stock may be owned or withheld in famine.
scenes.goal: Recover the heat-tolerant seed stock and the satellite codes, and shelter from the solar storm in the shielded halls.
scenes.outcome: Tamsin chooses to share both seeds and codes. They carry the seeds and records home after the storm passes, and Kesra spends her own filters for the return.
scenes.summary: Sheltered in the vault, the heroes find the seeds and the archived codes and decide how they will use them.
scenes.title: Seeds and Records

scenes.conflict: Marek wants the seeds and codes kept under Council authority. The Seedkeeper principle, the Dustwalkers' trade demands and the Wardens' wish to reclaim the satellite all collide with his fear of losing the stores.
scenes.goal: Convince the Council to share the seed stock with all Greenholds and allow the codes to be used on the satellite.
scenes.outcome: Orrin publicly claims the Seedkeeper principle and Juno stands openly with Tamsin. Marek, faced with the seed-sharing custom and the proof, yields and opens the stores.
scenes.summary: The returning heroes force the political fight. Orrin, Juno and Kesra each take a stand.
scenes.title: Before the Council

scenes.conflict: The beam is still burning the fields, and the Array must stay powered through the solar storm's aftermath. Tamsin must work with others rather than improvise alone.
scenes.goal: Upload the vault codes through the Array's uplink and take control of Helios Wake.
scenes.outcome: Tamsin and Juno apply the codes together with Marek's support and refocus the satellite's reflector away from Westreach, ending the immediate threat.
scenes.summary: Tamsin and Juno complete the work Tamsin's mother started, and Marek authorizes the resources.
scenes.title: Reclaiming Helios Wake

scenes.conflict: Marek's habit of control and Kesra's guarded bargaining make trust between Westreach and the Dustwalkers fragile.
scenes.goal: Distribute the heat-tolerant seed stock and agree a fair trade pact.
scenes.outcome: Marek opens the stores and agrees to share seed stock with all Greenholds. Kesra's fair trade pact is sealed and Orrin teaches openly.
scenes.summary: Orrin plants the first vault seeds in the living walls, and Marek and Kesra sign the pact.
scenes.title: Seeds for Every Greenhold

scenes.conflict: Costs of the crisis remain: scorched fields, lost time and the grief of Tamsin's mother's absence.
scenes.goal: Mark the end of the crisis and the start of rebuilding.
scenes.outcome: The community looks to a shared future. Tamsin's arc is complete as she credits others, and the terraces begin to regrow.
scenes.summary: New seedlings rise in the terraces at dawn, and the characters reflect on what cooperation made possible.
scenes.title: Dawn on the Terraces

logline: When the rogue satellite Helios Wake begins burning Greenhold Westreach just before a solar storm, a young engineer and a reclusive botanist must cross the toxic Glasswind Wastes to the forgotten Deepseed Vault, and they must win the Council over to sharing its seeds and codes with every Greenhold.
theme: Survival depends on sharing knowledge and resources, not hoarding them.
title: Greenhold
